Chapter 15 of 16 · Help

When something looks wrong

Missing conversations, unconfirmed sends, lost drafts, chips about Spruce and Gmail, and who to ask.

Something seems to be missing

  • A whole mailbox's email is gone. The top of Messages says A mailbox needs reconnecting in Settings › Inboxes. Its email is hidden here until then. An admin reconnects it there.
  • Texts from one line are gone. That Spruce line may have been switched off in Settings › Inboxes.
  • I can't find a patient by name. Search matches the name as Healthie spells it. Try part of the name, or their email, or search by the email's subject or sender. A patient with no conversations in Messages has no row to find.
  • A conversation isn't under the patient. It may be in Needs matching, or be a fax line or a shared number or address, whose messages are linked one at a time. See Needs matching.
  • An email says its text is hidden, or its subject is hidden. It was linked to this patient on its own from a shared address, or its conversation moved to this patient; Billing and providers see only that it is there until front desk shows it to them. See Mixed conversations.
  • A fax line has no Not a patient. Archive it instead. See Needs matching.
  • I only see some patients. Billing and providers see the patients handed to them, plus any patient they're tagged on while the tag is live. See Who sees what.
  • Messages isn't in my sidebar, or says it's not open to me. Ask an admin to check Settings › Messages access.

Call doesn't connect

  • The box says my phone or calls aren't set up. Ask an admin: your mobile goes on your entry on People, your login has to be linked to you on Users, and the line calls go out from is set in Settings › Inboxes.
  • I dialed and nothing happened. Dial from the phone ending in the digits the box shows, and dial straight away. Close the box, press Call again, and dial the new number.
  • Healthie has no number for the patient. Add it in Healthie, then try again.

A send says Not confirmed

Wait a few minutes, then look before sending again: at the timeline, the mailbox's Sent folder in Gmail, or the conversation in Spruce. Messages never retries on its own, so nothing goes out twice unless you send it twice. See Replying and notes.

My draft disappeared

Drafts live only on the page. Messages asks before you leave a draft behind, and your browser warns before a reload or closing the tab. An idle sign-out or a change to your access still loses it without asking, so don't leave a long reply unsent when you step away.

Archive left something open

Archive never closes a conversation that changed after you opened the patient, or after the list showed the row. Read what's new, then press Archive again. A conversation that couldn't be loaded stays open until it loads.

Chips about Spruce and Gmail

Once an admin turns on Archive in Spruce and Gmail, a conversation that Spruce or Gmail didn't follow says so, on the patient or the conversation, and its row in the list shows a small warning triangle:

  • Archived in Spruce. A newer message keeps it open here. (or Gmail): someone archived it there while a message here was newer. Read it, then archive it here.
  • Not archived in Spruce yet. Retrying. or Not back in the Spruce inbox yet. Retrying.: Messages keeps trying on its own. Nothing to do unless it stays for hours.
  • Couldn't archive in Gmail, or Couldn't move it back to the Gmail inbox: Gmail or Spruce refused. Press Try again. If it keeps failing, archive it in Gmail or Spruce yourself and tell an admin.
  • Couldn't archive in Gmail: reconnect the mailbox in Settings › Inboxes. or Couldn't archive in Spruce: Spruce refused Messages' access.: an admin needs to fix the connection. Try again once they have.
  • This conversation is no longer in Spruce. (or Gmail): it was deleted there. Nothing more follows; Messages keeps what it had.

The page says it's reconnecting

Reconnecting. This patient is hidden until it refreshes. means the dashboard couldn't confirm your access for a few minutes, usually a network blip. It comes back on its own. Your draft is kept.

Who to ask

If the dashboard or Messages won't work at all, keep working from the Spruce app and Gmail: see If Messages is down.

For access, mailboxes, Spruce lines or anything that looks broken, ask your dashboard admin. Don't send patient details over Slack or email to explain a problem; say which row or patient ID, and what you expected.

Chapter 16 of 16 · Help

If Messages is down

Working from Spruce and Gmail when the dashboard won't work, what waits until it's back, and how Messages catches up.

Calls and texts don't go through Messages

Messages shows what is in Spruce and Gmail and sends your replies through them. It isn't the phone system or the mail server:

  • Calls ring in Spruce, and texts, voicemails and faxes arrive there, the same as before Messages. Nothing in Messages changes how calls ring, the phone menu, forwarding or voicemail.
  • Email arrives in the practice Gmail mailboxes.

So if the dashboard stops working, patients can still call, text, fax and email the practice as usual, and nothing they send is lost. It is all in Spruce and Gmail.

How to tell

Messages may be down if:

  • the dashboard won't load or won't sign you in;
  • Messages keeps saying Reconnecting. This patient is hidden until it refreshes.;
  • nothing new shows in Messages for a while, though you know patients have called or written.

Ask a coworker whether theirs works too, and tell your dashboard admin either way.

Work from Spruce and Gmail

Until Messages is back:

  • Calls, texts, voicemails and faxes: use the Spruce app on your phone or computer. Call patients back from there too, since Call in Messages won't work.
  • Email: open the practice mailbox in Gmail and reply there.
  • A reply you were typing: copy it before you reload or close the page, then send it from Spruce or Gmail. Drafts live only on the page.
  • Notes: Messages doesn't show Spruce's internal notes, so a note you write in Spruce stays in Spruce. Once Messages is back, add what the team needs as a note there.
  • Hand-offs, tags and Save to chart wait until Messages is back. If something can't wait for Billing or a provider, tell them directly.
  • A reply set for 8:00 AM: Spruce sends these itself, so they still go out on time. If you had just moved a conversation and its reply card still said Cancelling the 8:00 AM reply…, cancel that reply in the Spruce app yourself, before 8:00 AM. See A reply scheduled for 8:00 AM.

What waits

When the whole system behind the dashboard is down, and not only the page, these stop too until it is back:

  • the dashboard, and Call in Messages;
  • the automated texts the practice has turned on, such as intake reminders, booking nudges, Zocdoc intake nudges, review requests, and billing and copay texts;
  • the Slack messages people get when a patient is handed to them or they are tagged;
  • Archive in Spruce and Gmail, if an admin has turned it on;
  • cancelling a reply set for 8:00 AM after its conversation moved.

If only the page is broken, the automated texts and Messages' own background work may carry on. You can't tell which from the front desk, so work from Spruce and Gmail either way.

Automated texts after an outage

They don't all go out the moment the system is back, and some are skipped:

  • Intake reminders and booking nudges start again at their next daily send. A patient who missed one gets one text, not several.
  • Zocdoc intake nudges start again within the hour, or at 8:00 AM if it's night, but not for a patient who booked more than 30 hours earlier.
  • Review requests and billing follow-ups that were due meanwhile may go out late, or not at all.
  • Texts set off by something that happened in Healthie while the system was down, such as the booking-link text when a patient finishes their intake forms, or the text when a copay card is declined, may not go out at all.

Tell your admin when it went down and when it came back, so they can check who may have missed a text.

When Messages is back

Messages catches up on its own. You don't have to do anything to bring in what arrived meanwhile.

  • Texts, calls, voicemails and faxes from while it was down come in, usually within minutes and longer after a long outage. They come in as new, so one nobody answered shows as Waiting.
  • Email comes in from where Messages left off. After a week or so down, a mailbox shows Catching up on missed mail until it's done. See Gmail mailboxes.
  • Replies you sent from the Spruce app or Gmail show in Messages too, and they answer the patient the usual way. See Waiting.
  • A call you made from the Spruce app shows, but a call never answers a patient. Once you've called them back, archive them.

Then tidy up:

  • Archive in Messages what you already handled in Spruce or Gmail. With Archive in Spruce and Gmail on, some of it may close on its own, and some may say Archived in Spruce. A newer message keeps it open here. (or Gmail). Read it, then archive it here.
  • A reply that was going out when Messages went down may say Not confirmed. Look in Spruce or Gmail before you send it again. See When a send isn't confirmed.
  • A reply set for 8:00 AM may say Not confirmed or Sent or cancelled afterwards. Check the conversation in Spruce.

Keep the fallback ready

All of this works only if you can get into Spruce and Gmail without the dashboard. Before you need it:

  • Keep a working Spruce login of your own, with the Spruce app installed and signed in on your phone and your computer.
  • Make sure the front desk can sign in to the practice mailbox in Gmail.
  • Every so often, open both and check that you're still signed in.

For admins: when the practice reviews who has a Spruce login, keep one for everyone who answers the phones.
